description: Realizable-vs-theoretical edge check against live CLOB order-book depth, AND Polymarket's own taker fee, which is never zero and is folded in rather than left for you to add (fleet #3446: r/PredictionsMarkets flagged a "clean" fill that quietly omitted it as optimistic in the direction that loses money). REQUIRES one of `market` (single-market mode) or `event` (basket/partition mode). SINGLE-MARKET: pass a market slug/URL + side (buy_yes|sell_yes|buy_no|sell_no, default buy_yes) + size_usd (defa

event.description: Basket mode: event slug or full polymarket.com URL, checks every leg of the partition.

market.description: Single-market mode: market slug or full polymarket.com URL.

side.description: Single-market: buy_yes | sell_yes | buy_no | sell_no (default buy_yes). Basket: sell_yes | buy_yes (default auto, sell if partition sum > 1, buy if < 1).

size_usd.description: Single-market: USD to spend (buys) or target proceeds (sells). Basket: settlement notional, shares per leg, each paying $1 at resolution. Default 1000, clamp 10-1,000,000.

name: nlrb__polymarket_fill_risk
